name: Amorita Resort
short_description: An award-winning clifftop beach resort on Panglao Island, Bohol, with a Cliff Deck ceremony spot overlooking the Bohol Sea.
full_description: Amorita Resort sits atop a limestone cliff on Panglao Island, Bohol, offering sweeping views of the Bohol Sea. The multi-award-winning boutique resort has 98 rooms, suites, and villas, two infinity pools, and several distinct wedding spaces — including the Cliff Deck for sunset ceremonies and poolside areas for receptions — making it a favored destination-wedding venue for couples wanting an island backdrop.
